subFunnel.description: Each case with its sequence, version and dates: the past-to-present tracker.

mirror.title: Mirror validation
mirror.description: The issued policy against the issuance proposal, field by field. Nothing self-corrects: each difference is resolved with an endorsement.
mirror.emptyHint: No differences between what was proposed and what was issued.
mirror.missingSources: Confirmed extractions are missing for the comparison: {{sources}}
mirror.noPermission: You need permission to create endorsements.

warranty.title: Warranties and recommendations
warranty.description: The R-n / G-n / M-n code runs through inspection, policy, collection and claim. Its status decides coverage.
warranty.emptyHint: Warranties come from category-A inspection recommendations and from the engineering plan.

actions.issueHint: Attach the endorsement issued by the carrier and apply the deltas to the policy and the collection plan.

issueDialog.title: Register the issued endorsement
issueDialog.documentHint: The document must already be uploaded to the case file (08A / 08B / 09B / 09D).

effectDiff.description: One row per changed dimension: before, after and delta.

premiumDelta.description: Deltas keep their sign: an exclusion or a decrease is negative.

installment.title: Instalment ledger
installment.description: Σ instalments = policy gross premium + Σ endorsement deltas. The last instalment absorbs the rounding.
installment.emptyHint: Instalments come from the carrier's payment plan (document 09).

balance.title: Balance check
balance.ok: The ledger matches the policy and its endorsements.
balance.mismatch: The ledger does NOT balance: fix the instalments or register the missing endorsement.

installment.noPermission: You need permission to edit collections.

art528.title: Article 528 — coverage termination and reinstatement
art528.description: Non-payment terminates the cover by operation of law; reinstatement has a date and a cost.
art528.emptyHint: Cover was never suspended for non-payment on this plan.
art528.gapWarning: A loss occurring inside this window is not covered.

claim.title: Claims
claim.subtitle: From the notice to the final adjustment, with warranty causality in plain sight.

claimItem.title: Claim items
claimItem.description: The adjuster's progression for each item: notified, determined, damage, deductible and indemnity.
claimItem.emptyHint: Items come from the tables of the adjuster's report.

adjuster.title: Adjuster reports
adjuster.description: Preliminary and final reports, with the warranty causality analysis.

adjuster.analyzeHint: Extracts the ruling, the warranty causality and the quantification. It writes nothing: it stays a suggestion.
adjuster.analyzeNoPermission: You need permission to upload documents.

adjuster.suggestionOnly: Unconfirmed AI suggestion — review it before relying on it.

counterfactual.description: What this same loss would have cost under the previous program. This is the renewal argument.
counterfactual.emptyHint: The final report contains it; read the report with AI to bring it in.
counterfactual.benefitHint: The difference in the insured's favour from placing this program.
counterfactual.renewalStory: Keep this reading for the renewal conversation.
